Switched source and compiled notes
Updated export screenshot
Fixed a typo with the last commit

Copy over the new plugin directory and remove __pycache__ dirs

The plugin directory was moved recently but the compile script had not been updated to move this across.
Automated the removal of __pycache__ directories so they do not need to be deleted manually after.
Fixed an error if there were no plugins

Improved reader

This seems to have fixed the last of the major models exported in a large group

Fixed loading issue

I don't know when this became an issue (I thought it wasn't an issue but I stumbled across it)
When the game path is changed it should automatically reload the game but it wasn't
Added entity group to test formatting default

Added search after loading

If a search term was typed before the game had finished loading it would show results not captured by the search. This should fix that.
Added a few more file readers

Added a bunch more type readers

This improves entity group support

Fixed model scaling again

I found some models where the scaling factor in the vert table was incorrect but the one later in the file was correct. Using the sign of the vert table scale to fix that issue and the final scale factor to do the actual scaling

Optimised unhiding treeview entries

Previously an entry could have the recursive unhide process run multiple times which is unneeded and slow. This check removes the extra processing

Improved searching

The program now doesn't freeze each time you type a character in the search bar. It will instead run the search if there is a 0.15 second gap between characters entered

Connected extra search features to the UI

The UI can now control case sensitivity and enable regex
Also improved the search bar
Currently search is executed for each time a letter changes which can slow down the program. Tried using threading.Timer but it made things rather unstable

Added improved search

The new search is much quicker and has the back end features to be a lot more powerful. These features need hooking up to the UI
Merge branch 'master' into dev

[ACU] Fixed model scaling

A previous commit had broken model scaling so merged meshes were messed up. This fixes that and also is hopefully the way that scaling is actually implemented
(the scaling factor in the vertex table is an actual scaling factor after you have normalised the verticies from -1 to 1)
Added 010 Editor texture template
[ACU Reader] Added notes from texture research
[ACU Plugin] Fixed an old pyUbiForge error
[Internals] Fixed texconv name
addex Xentax link to readme

Simplified texconv

The dll method was not the way to go. Put texconv in its own module that will pick the correct one based on the platform. This will make adding other platforms easier

Revert "replaced texconv exe with texconv dll"

This reverts commit 2d60075fe26409f98d3ffc4072383d7bc519c972.
[ACU] Cleaned up texture

replaced texconv exe with texconv dll

I think I may be able to make platform variants making this viable on other OSs

Moved the lzo dll files into pyUbiForge

These program extensions are part of pyUbiForge so they have been moved to respect this
[ACU Reader] Cube map container
Fixed another pyUbiForge reference

Moved plugins next to UI

Plugins are now seperate to pyUbiForge which is just an API to the files and reading them into python classes. This allows the plugins to potentially use Qt and cleans up pyUbiForge a bit.

[UI] Populate the forge file entries first

Populate the forge file entries before the datafile entires. Doing this means that they instantly appear rather than slowly over time
